breakdown.description: The global horizontal traction on the left slope is reinterpreted as slope-aligned tangential shear
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a contradiction, first specifying a horizontal traction and then reinterpreting it as a slope-aligned tangential shear traction. The ground truth resolved this by clarifying the load should be a 'horizontal traction only on the left slope'. The generated specification instead adopted the incorrect, contradictory instruction, stating to 'Apply a tangential shear traction... aligned with the direction of the edge'. This fails to correct the error and does not align with the ground truth's fix.
